newsitem.title: UK: London Insurance to hold 65 pct in Bankside.
newsitem.headline: London Insurance to hold 65 pct in Bankside.

text.p: London Insurance Market Investment Trust Plc (LIMIT) said on Friday that it would acquire 65 percent interest in the Bankside Underwriting Agencies Ltd (BUAL).
Bankside Underwriting is the holding company of Bankside Syndicates Ltd, the managing agency of Lloyds and Garwyn Ltd.
LIMIT said in a statement that the acquisition would be carried out by one of its subsidiaries to renamed Bankside Insurance Holdings Plc (BIH).

It said that shareholders holding 37 percent of the share capital in BUAL would be accepting cash or loan notes in exchange for their shares. The total cost would come to around 7.7 million stg. The rest would be in form of shares in BIH.

BIH, through LIMIT, would have a dedicated underwriting capacity of 95 million stg with effect from January 1, 1997. LIMIT said it had agreed to indemnify BIH against any losses, up to an amount of 25 million stg, incurred by BIH or its subsidiaries.
"It is the intention of the boards of BIH and LIMIT that BIH should eventually seek a flotation on the London Stock Exchange," LIMIT said.

Bankside managed eight syndicates at Lloyd's with total underwriting capacity of 403 million stg. During the year ended September 30, 1996 it made profits of 8.9 million stg while its net tangible assets stood at 5.6 million stg.
